app_description: Professional browser-based photo editor workspace inspired by industry standard desktop image suites, featuring custom canvas, layer management, non-destructive tools, filters, crop/resize, text, and undo/redo without mandatory account creation.

layout.grids: dense dashboard grid for layers and properties

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Implement the exact Photopea-like professional layout: top menu bar, tool options bar, vertical left tool palette, central interactive HTML5 canvas workspace with pan/zoom and layers, right-hand collapsible panels for Layers, History, Adjustments, and Info. Support image upload, filters (brightness, contrast, blur, grayscale, sepia, invert), crop, brush, shapes, text insertion, history undo/redo, and export. Use dark professional workspace styling with clean borders and high contrast controls.
